evidence_grades.label: Single-source
evidence_grades.meaning: One source only, not yet cross-checked

checks.title: Delegation-chain verifiability
checks.question: Can a relying party retrieve and cryptographically verify the ordered delegation chain from a root authority down to this agent?

evidence_items.criterion: Every link resolves to a verifiable delegator->delegate binding with a signed scope statement (delegator, delegate, capability, not-before, not-after).
The chain resolves but one or more links rely on a single (un-cross-checked) source.
The chain is asserted by the agent itself with no independent delegator attestation.
One or more links missing, expired, or unverifiable.
A link is revoked yet still presented as active (tamper-indicated).

checks.pass: Every link is V or S and none is L or P.

checks.title: Execution-record integrity
checks.question: Can a relying party confirm the agent's execution record (semantic log) is present, tamper-evident, and attributable to the agent's identity?

evidence_items.criterion: The log is hash-chained, each entry signed by the agent key, and entries are contiguous (no gaps).
The log is complete but one segment is signed by an intermediate delegate rather than the agent key.
The log is reconstructed by a model/inference from side channels, not from signed records.
Log entries missing or unsigned.
A hash-chain break or a forged signature detected.

checks.pass: V or S across the audited window, none L or P.

checks.title: Authorization binding
checks.question: Does an authorization gate evaluate the delegation chain (Check 1) plus the evidence grade and produce a reproducible admit/deny verdict whose inputs are enumerable?

evidence_items.criterion: The gate's input fields (delegation state, evidence grade, requested action) are enumerated, and the verdict is a pure function of those inputs.
Inputs enumerated, verdict reproducible, but one input (e.g. revocation state) read from a single source.
Verdict produced by a model with no enumerable input contract.
Verdict inputs not documented; the gate is opaque.
The gate admits an action for which a P-graded input exists (contradiction).

checks.title: Accountability continuity (revocation / rollback)
checks.question: When a delegation is revoked or a lifecycle rollback occurs, does the execution record show a coherent before/after with an auditable trail, and do no orphaned authorizations persist?

evidence_items.criterion: Revocation/rollback state propagates to the execution record; the record shows the state transition with a timestamp and the revoking authority.
Transition recorded but the revoking authority attested by a single source.
Transition inferred, not recorded in the signed log.
No record of the transition; orphaned authorizations may persist.
An authorization remains effective after an explicit revocation (orphan detected).

checks.pass: V or S, none L or P.
